# Pull Request

**Contribution policy:** Code contributions are not currently accepted;
suggestions, bug reports, and comments are welcome. Pull requests carrying
unsolicited code will not be merged — maintainers may convert them into
issues so the idea is not lost.

## For maintainer-initiated work

- [ ] This pull request is maintainer-initiated (or explicitly coordinated
      with the maintainers)
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits: `type(scope): summary`
- [ ] Change is minimal and scoped to one logical unit (no speculative
      refactoring)
- [ ] Scoped lint/format checks pass for every touched file type
- [ ] Code comments follow the doc-comment dialect of the language; TODO
      markers use `TODO(family-timecraft/<repo>#N)`
- [ ] Documentation is updated in the same change; links are relative
      intra-repository and absolute canonical GitHub URLs across repositories
- [ ] No development-process artifacts (planning docs, research notes, agent
      instructions) enter code or documentation
